description: Go back to a previous version: its own build is put back in about half a minute, nothing is rebuilt, and the database stays as it is now, so the older code has to work with the database as it is. Only the last 10 builds can be put back (VERSION_UNAVAILABLE otherwise). Restoring the data from before a change is not available yet.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

to.description: Target deployment id. Defaults to the previous live version.

name: rollback
title: Go back to a version
